title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Occurrence
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Occurrence. The fact of something existing or being found in a place, detectable by wearables (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.5), e.g. a queue detected by a crowd-control wearable (TS 103 410-9 Figure 9's ex:ToiletsQueue). Kept as its own standalone entity -- unlike the WearableProperty/WearerProperty/BiometricProperty/ElectricalProperty/ElectricalSafetyProperty/EmissionProperty/EnvironmentProperty/EnvironmentalProperty/CrowdProperty grouping classes, which were flattened into attributes of WearableDevice/Wearer -- because an Occurrence has real identity and structure of its own (a detecting device, a place, a time) rather than being merely the domain of a named measurement-kind individual; SAREF4CITY's s4city:Event is a documented subclass of this same class for city-scale occurrences. A 'name' attribute (not itself declared by the ontology) is added for readability, mirroring the descriptive individual names used in the ontology's own examples (ex:ToiletsQueue).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Occurrence'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Short descriptive label for the occurrence, mirroring the ontology's own example individual names (e.g. ex:ToiletsQueue). Not itself an ontology-declared property.

isDetectedBy.description: Relationship. Device(s) detecting this occurrence (s4wear:isDetectedBy). Links to one or more WearableDevice entities.

takesPlaceAt.description: GeoProperty. Model:'https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#Point'. The place where the occurrence takes place (s4wear:takesPlaceAt, range geosp:Feature).
